verdict.overall: Since Sunday the biggest movers are ZETA (+6.8%), PLTR (+5.8%) and TSLA (+4.9%), all climbing hard, while NVDA (-1.5%) and AVGO (-2.2%) have drifted lower in their downtrends. Range-based setups look cleanest on META and AMAT, where magnets sit above price with no near-term earnings risk, whereas AMD, PLTR, NVDA, ZETA and MU all carry earnings or pricey options within the next month, and several (NVDA, AMD, ZETA, PLTR) show options turning opposing further out — confidence in the strongest movers is rising short-term but softening into November.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: stronger — price up about 5% to 372, sitting right on the 372.5 magnet level. Options point to resistance building near 400 into mid-November, with two of the next four weeks leaning against further gains.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: weaker — price down about 2% to 321.68, trend still pointing down. It's hovering just above the 320 floor, with options neutral and a magnet level drifting between 340 and 350 over the next month.
tickers.META: No Sunday baseline. META trades at 642.62 in a downtrend, with neutral options throughout and magnets rising toward 680-700, well above price, suggesting room to climb before meeting resistance.
tickers.AMD: No Sunday baseline. AMD sits at 516.79 in a downtrend with pricey options, a floor near 475-510 and ceiling near 540-560 for the next three weeks, turning against the stock by November 20. Earnings on November 3 add risk.
tickers.MU: No Sunday baseline. MU trades at 877.55 in a downtrend, options fairly priced to pricey, with a floor near 800 and magnets drifting from 930 down to 900 over the month. No earnings in this window.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: stronger — price up nearly 6% to 196.75. Options turn against the stock for the 11-13 and 11-20 expiries with magnets falling to 175-195, and pricing gets pricey further out. Earnings land November 2.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: weaker — price down about 1.5% to 210.96, trend down. Options are pricey across the board and turn against the stock by November 20 with a 210 magnet and floor down at 190. Earnings due November 17.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: stronger — price up nearly 7% to 33.98. Options lean against the stock most weeks with pricey to very pricey pricing, and magnets fall from 31.5 to 30 over the month. Earnings on November 3 add extra risk.
tickers.AMAT: No Sunday baseline. AMAT at 377.24 in a downtrend, RSI oversold. Options stay neutral and fairly priced, with magnets climbing from about 402 to 460 over the month — above price, a hopeful sign. Earnings November 12.
tickers.SPY: No Sunday or prior baseline available. SPY at 759.97 in a downtrend, options pricey despite low volatility, with a floor near 745 (£106) and ceiling 800 (£114) for this week's expiry, magnet around 765 (£109).
tickers.QQQ: No Sunday or prior baseline available. QQQ at 704.4 in a downtrend, pricey options, floor 700 and ceiling 740 this week with magnet 725 — roughly £79 floor, £81 ceiling, £80 magnet in ISUS terms, rough since ISUS only partly tracks the Nasdaq.
